source_text: Local beliefs emphasize FGM's role in controlling female sexuality to preserve purity and prevent promiscuity, with many Gambians asserting that uncut girls "like men too much" or risk premarital sex, pregnancy, or infidelity, thus safeguarding family honor and marital fidelity. [16]
